_doc: Shared step types. hours_per_lot = lot_size / throughput_wph + overhead_hours (or batch_hours for batch tools). Throughputs are nominal vendor-class figures; scrap rates are modelling assumptions (see docs/TECHNICAL.md s4).

litho_euv._source: ASML NXE:3600D spec: 160 wph (asml.com); overhead = reticle change + track + lot setup (assumption)

litho_duv._source: ASML NXT:2000i-class immersion, ~275 wph nominal (asml.com DUV product line); overhead assumption

dep._source: blend of CVD/ALD/PVD cluster tools, assumption

thermal._source: vertical furnace / anneal batch incl. ramp, assumption

litho.mechanism: overlay misalignment accumulates as a random walk over exposure passes: error ~ sqrt(N) ~ t^0.5

etch.mechanism: trench/profile non-uniformity and micro-loading grow roughly linearly with etch time

dep.mechanism: particle adders in the chamber scale with exposure time

cmp.mechanism: scratches, dishing and erosion scale with polish time

thermal.mechanism: dopant diffusion length L = sqrt(D*t): variance grows as t^0.5

clean.mechanism: removes defects; modelled as zero contribution
